name: PQ Addons – Creative Elementor Widgets
author: Peacefulqode

sections.installation:
1. Upload the pq-addons folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Open Elementor and enjoy the new PQ Addons!
sections.faq:
Is this plugin free?

Yes, PQ Addons – Creative Elementor Widgets is completely free and licensed under GPLv2 or later.

Does it work with the latest version of Elementor?

Yes, it is regularly tested with the latest versions of Elementor and WordPress.

Can I use it with Elementor Pro?

Yes. It works perfectly with both the free and Pro versions of Elementor.
sections.description:
Short description: Adds custom Elementor widgets and dashboard tools for faster, advanced website building.

Features:

  • 10+ custom Elementor widgets.
  • Dashboard and template management options.
  • Lightweight and optimized for performance.
  • 100% responsive and translation-ready.
  • Compatible with the latest Elementor and WordPress versions.
  • It includes pre-designed widgets, dashboard enhancements, and tools that boost your Elementor workflow — all optimized for performance and flexibility.
  • PQ Addons – Creative Elementor Widgets adds advanced custom widgets and extensions for Elementor, helping you build professional websites faster and more creatively.
